title: Concept: Conan lock entry with no recipe revision
description: conan.lock declares a locked reference without a `#revision` suffix, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a locked reference without a `#revision` suffix.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through conan.lock (conan).
risk: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a locked reference without a `#revision` suffix.
